invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.23.0 preserves the completed billing product, verified merchant payment connections, customer Pay Now, M-PESA STK/C2B reconciliation, truthful webhook health, provider-authoritative refunds, and auth-safe API boundaries. Pending gateway refund work is stored only in the existing integration_events ledger; financial refund tables remain posted/reversed settlement records. Stripe, PayPal, Paystack and Flutterwave refunds post financially only after provider-confirmed success; Pesapal requires explicit merchant completion confirmation because request acceptance is not settlement. Unsupported automatic reversals such as M-PESA require explicit confirmation that the external reversal was completed before SaMi records the financial refund. Completed external refunds cannot be reversed internally. Invoicing API tenant/company authentication failures are normalized to 401/403 rather than generic 500 responses. The release gate includes Invoicing/payment/refund regressions, Accounting parity, quality locks, migrations, responsive/app UI, ERP integration, TypeScript and production build.
